items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Lou Rawls as someone 'he' (a previous speaker) mentioned; Interviewee does not mention Lou Rawls or claim any personal connection.

ctx.x: And I'll tell you another which he mentioned too, which is an oldtimer, Lou Rawls; he mentioned him, and he's been around a long time.

Do you think big bands as we knew them, because of course there are always going to be a few around, do you think big bands as we knew them will ever come back? Big bands, four trumpets, four trombones, five reeds and full rhythm section, like the Basie type of thing, do you think it will ever come back?
